title: The Henslowe-Alleyn Digitisation Project
institution: Dulwich College, with King's Digital Lab, King's College London
notes: Digitised manuscripts of the Henslowe-Alleyn papers at Dulwich College (Philip Henslowe's diary and account book 1592-1609, the Rose and Fortune playhouse contracts, letters, deeds, Edward Alleyn's papers 1612-1626), with essays and a set of transcriptions. All the documents date from 1450-1700 (about 1587-1626). The transcriptions are PDF documents. Although the catalogue says the diary and account book is transcribed, Henslowe's diary (MSS 7) is given only as images; the transcribed items are seven documents and Alleyn's diary (MSS 9, 116 page transcripts). The counts cover the seven documents; Alleyn's diary, mostly sums of money, falls under the corpus filter for text with too few letters. The old address henslowe-alleyn.org.uk/index.html returns HTTP 500 but the root address works. Site footer reads 2026, maintained by King's Digital Lab. robots.txt asks for a 10-second crawl delay. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
